subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: What aspects of the films are reviewers focusing on?

judge.implied_focus: The film aspects/dimensions reviewers focus on (e.g., cinematography, acting, plot, music, effects, overall quality)

per_column.name: aspects_discussed
per_column.rationale: Directly extracts the multi-label set of film aspects each review discusses, which is precisely the focus concept the query asks about.

per_column.name: num_aspects
per_column.rationale: Count of distinct aspects per review; a coherent facet describing the breadth/intensity of aspect coverage, structurally derived from and complementing the aspect set.

judge.rationale: Both columns centre tightly on a single, data-inferable focus: which film aspects reviewers attend to. 'aspects_discussed' captures the categorical aspect set (cinematography, acting, plot, music, effects, overall_quality) and 'num_aspects' adds a coherent quantitative facet (coverage breadth). This is not a grab-bag nor a mere restatement of review_text. The structure is sound but modest: it provides the aspect set plus a count, without further decomposition (e.g., per-aspect sentiment or aspect-by-label breakdown), which slightly limits structure_quality. The focus is clearly actionable -- an analyst can quantify aspect frequency, correlate aspects with label_pos, and study review depth.
